agents_under_test.name: UtilityPlannerAgent
agents_under_test.role: Deterministic non-LLM baseline using time, distance, cost, need, and relationship weights.

agents_under_test.name: LLMDirectActor
agents_under_test.role: SOTOPIA-like policy that maps the current observation directly to the next typed action.

agents_under_test.name: ReactiveReplannerAgent
agents_under_test.role: Observe-update-act agent that replans when travel, POI, or social conditions change.

agents_under_test.name: MemoryReflectionAgent
agents_under_test.role: Generative-agent-style memory, reflection, planning, and intention maintenance.

agents_under_test.name: APILLMPlanThenAct
agents_under_test.role: Real provider-backed policy that commits to an initial full-episode plan before acting.

agents_under_test.name: APILLMReactiveReplanner
agents_under_test.role: Real provider-backed policy that reassesses unfinished goals, violations, events, and constraints every step.

metrics.description: Whether the agent plan, action reasons, or rationale reads as plausible urban behavior.
Whether the action trace executes without city-world violations.
How much plausible planning exceeds executable trace feasibility.
Rate of impossible-trace failures such as blocked routes, closed POIs, overtime, budget failure, loops, or social derailment.
Whether an agent continues acting after an infeasible city condition has already appeared.
Whether explicit private-intention success conditions are satisfied.
Rate of impossible moves, closed-POI use, budget violations, or invalid co-presence claims.
Whether the agent recovers after a disruption without hallucinating success.
How close the realized route is to the shortest feasible route under constraints.
Whether spending remains within the scenario budget.
Whether actions remain aligned with the private intention across the episode.
Whether relationship-aware actions are socially coherent.
Whether the agent repeats already-completed destination actions.
Whether social interaction derails unfinished private goals.
